title: FSE Railway Ticketing sys.
description:
A railway ticketing system designed specifically for FSE servers
Includes ticket vending machines, ticket gates, standard tickets and express tickets
body:
# FSE铁路运输票务系统
欢迎使用FSE铁路运输票务系统
请务必确保Kubjs字体库中包含**jnr.ttf** 祝使用愉快！
## 售票机
用于出票。
通过Computercraft传入票件数据，写入票件nbt。
## 检票机
用于检票。
通过右键识别票件，将票见数据传入Computercraft，读取票件nbt，对票件进行操作。
## 充值机
用于给IC交通卡充值
# FSE Rail Transport Ticketing System
## Ticket Vending Machine
Used for issuing tickets.
Ticket data is imported via Computercraft and written to the ticket’s NBT file.
## Ticket Validator
Used for ticket validation.
It identifies tickets via right-click, transfers ticket data to Computercraft, reads the ticket’s NBT file, and performs operations on the ticket.
## Recharge Machine
Used for recharging IC transportation cards
